crossRefs.note: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
crossRefs.keyword: open flowers. or, openings of flowers

translations.web: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers. All was cedar. No stone was visible.
translations.bsb: The cedar paneling inside the temple was carved with gourds and open flowers. Everything was cedar; not a stone could be seen.
translations.kjv: And the cedar of the house within was carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
translations.asv: And there was cedar on the house within, carved with knops and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
